list.title: KPIs
list.intro: The KPI dictionary of this transformation, the latest status of each KPI and the reporting periods. Missing or old data shows as Unknown or Stale, never as zero or green.
list.statusIntro: The displayed RAG of each KPI with its actual, expected value to date and data freshness. Open a KPI for the full explanation.
list.statusEmptyBody: A status appears once a KPI has an active version.
list.dictionaryIntro: Each KPI with its active version and what is still missing before it can be measured.
list.dictionaryEmptyBody: Define KPIs in the Define tab first.

kpi.title: KPI
kpi.intro: The KPI's status panel, its versions, RAG thresholds, target trajectories, overrides and calculation runs.
kpi.missingIntro: This KPI cannot be measured yet. Still missing:

reason.no_accepted_actual: no accepted actual for this period
reason.no_active_version: the KPI has no active version
reason.stale: the latest value is older than the staleness limit
reason.value_out_of_range: the value is outside the valid range
reason.cumulative_incomplete: an earlier period is missing from the cumulative value
reason.aggregation_unit_mismatch: the values have different units or currencies
reason.no_rollup: this KPI has no roll-up rule
reason.stock_not_additive: stock values cannot be added across scopes
reason.scope_missing: an expected scope has no value
reason.due_date_unknown: no due date (no working-day calendar or not set)

missing.definition_active: The KPI definition is not active

panel.title: RAG panel
panel.intro: The seven elements behind the RAG of the current period. The explanation names the threshold and the trajectory used.
panel.overrideNote: Displayed as {{rag}} by a manual override (calculated: {{calculated}}) until {{until}}, set by {{by}}.

explanation.on_or_better_than_trajectory: The actual is on or better than the value expected to date.
explanation.amber_band: The actual is behind the value expected to date by more than the amber threshold, but not beyond the red threshold.
explanation.red_threshold: The actual is behind the value expected to date beyond the red threshold.
explanation.inside_band: The actual is inside the acceptable band.
explanation.outside_band: The actual is outside the acceptable band; the RAG follows how far outside it is.
explanation.milestone_not_yet_due: The milestone is not achieved yet, and it is not yet due.
explanation.milestone_overdue: The milestone is past its due date and not achieved.
explanation.before_trajectory: The period is before the first trajectory point, so there is no expected value yet.
explanation.no_approved_trajectory: There is no approved target trajectory, so there is nothing to compare with.
explanation.no_actual: There is no accepted actual for this period, so the RAG is Unknown.
explanation.not_computable: The value cannot be computed, so the RAG is Not computable.
explanation.stale: The latest actual is older than the staleness limit, so the RAG is Stale.
explanation.other: The RAG follows the KPI's rule.
explanation.thresholdConfigured: Threshold used: version {{version}} (configured), amber from {{amber}}, red from {{red}} ({{mode}}).
explanation.thresholdDefault: Threshold used: the default rule (no configured threshold), amber from {{amber}}, red from {{red}} ({{mode}}).
explanation.thresholdNone: No threshold was used for this result.

version.title: Versions
version.intro: How the KPI is measured. Only a draft can change; activating it supersedes the active version. A version needs an aggregation rule before it can be activated.
version.draftNote: A draft version is not used for measurement until it is activated.
version.emptyBody: Create a draft version to start measuring this KPI.
version.aggregationHint: Required before activation. Sum for flows, last value for stocks, weighted ratio for ratios, none for milestones.
version.formulaHint: Use the variable names below, for example revenue / customers.
version.evidenceRequired: Evidence required with every submitted value
version.changeReasonHint: Required for every version after the first.
version.percentHint: Enter a percentage, for example 12.5 for 12.5 %.
version.activateBody: The current active version (if any) is superseded and this version is used for every new actual and calculation.
version.requestApprovalNote: A business approval inside the product, decided by the mapped approver. It is not an engineering delivery gate.
version.label: Version {{n}}

threshold.title: RAG thresholds
threshold.intro: How far behind the expected value turns the RAG amber or red. Each change is a new version; without one, the default rule applies (amber from 5 %, red from 10 %).
threshold.empty: No configured threshold: the default rule applies.
threshold.emptyBody: The default rule is amber from 5 % and red from 10 % behind the expected value.
threshold.valueHint: Relative: a percentage (5 for 5 %). Absolute: an amount in the KPI's unit.

trajectory.title: Target trajectories
trajectory.intro: The expected value over time. A trajectory is used only after a business approval by someone other than its author.
trajectory.emptyBody: Without an approved trajectory, the expected value to date is Unknown.
trajectory.pointsHint: One point per line: a date (YYYY-MM-DD), a space, then the expected value.
trajectory.pointsHintPercent: One point per line: a date (YYYY-MM-DD), a space, then the expected percentage (12.5 for 12.5 %).
trajectory.approveNote: A business approval inside the product: once approved, this trajectory sets the expected values. You cannot approve a trajectory you created. It is not an engineering delivery gate.
trajectory.appendOnly: Points are fixed when the trajectory is created. Different points need a new version.

override.title: Manual RAG overrides
override.intro: An override changes the displayed RAG only, with a reason, evidence and an expiry. The calculated RAG is always kept and shown.
override.displayOnly: The calculated RAG does not change. After the expiry, the calculated RAG is displayed again.
override.expiresHint: Date and time in {{zone}}; at most 366 days ahead.

run.title: Calculation runs
run.intro: Each accepted actual, threshold change, approved trajectory or activated version triggers exactly one run.

period.title: Reporting periods
period.intro: The organization's reporting periods. Actuals are entered only for an open period. Without a business calendar, working-day due dates are Unknown.
period.emptyBody: An office role creates and opens the periods.
period.label: Period label
period.updateDueHint: Optional. Without it, the due date is Unknown.
period.openBody: Opening the period lets KPI owners enter their actuals for it and creates their update tasks.
period.closeBody: After closing, no new actual can be entered for this period. A closed period stays closed.
period.orgOnly: Reporting periods are organization records: your role cannot list them. The KPI screens use each KPI's current period.

update.title: Update KPI
update.intro: The routine update in four steps: the KPI, the period, the value (or why it is not available) with evidence, then submit.
update.formIntro: Complete the four steps in order. A saved draft is not submitted and is not used.
update.steps: Four steps: 1 KPI, 2 period, 3 value and evidence, 4 submit.
update.periodHint: Only open periods of this KPI's frequency are listed.
update.missingReason: Why the value is not available
update.missingHint: The KPI then shows Unknown for this period, never zero.
update.dataAsOfHint: The date the value describes (defaults to the end of the period).
update.evidenceRequired: This KPI requires evidence with every submitted value.
update.evidenceOptional: Attach the evidence behind the value (optional for this KPI).
update.noEvidence: No evidence in this transformation yet.
update.submitReviewNote: After submitting, the value waits for the reviewer and is not used until accepted.
update.submitDirectNote: This KPI accepts values on submission: the value is used at once.
update.draftNote: A draft is saved for you only: it is not submitted, not reviewed and not used.
update.readOnly: You can see this KPI's actuals but cannot submit them.
update.noOpenPeriod: No open {{frequency}} reporting period. Ask the transformation office to open one.
update.existingSlot: This period already has value version {{n}}. Your entry becomes version {{next}} of the same actual.

confirm.reviewPending: Review pending: the value is not used until the reviewer accepts it.
confirm.accepted: Accepted: the value is used now.
confirm.draftNotSubmitted: Saved as a draft: not submitted, not reviewed and not used.
confirm.downstream: Views that change when the value is accepted
confirm.downstreamDraft: Views that will change once the value is submitted and accepted
confirm.noDownstream: No other view depends on this KPI.
confirm.title: Update recorded for {{name}}

finance.not_applicable: No Finance review needed for this KPI.

downstream.formula_kpi: A KPI calculated from this one
downstream.benefit: A benefit measured by this KPI

actual.title: KPI actual
actual.intro: One KPI, scope and period: every value version and every review.
actual.valuesIntro: Every entry is kept. Only the accepted version is used.
actual.notUsedUntilAccepted: Review pending: this value is not used until it is accepted.
actual.draftNotUsed: Draft – not submitted: this value is not used.
actual.listIntro: Each period's actual, its status and its value versions.

review.title: KPI review queue
review.intro: Submitted KPI values waiting for your review. A value is used only after it is accepted.
review.queueIntro: Accept to use the value (one calculation run follows), or reject with a reason so the owner corrects it.
review.emptyBody: Submitted values of KPIs you review appear here.
review.acceptNote: Accepting uses this value at once and triggers one calculation run.
review.ownValue: You submitted this value, so someone else reviews it.

dq.title: KPI data quality
dq.intro: Data-quality findings recorded by the calculation runs. Resolve or dismiss each one with a note.
dq.listIntro: A finding is never deleted; its resolution note is kept.

ruleHelp.missing_actual: No actual was accepted for the period.
ruleHelp.stale: The latest value is older than the staleness limit.
ruleHelp.out_of_range: The value is outside the valid minimum or maximum.
ruleHelp.evidence_missing: The value has no evidence attached.
ruleHelp.zero_denominator: The ratio's denominator is zero, so it is not computable.
ruleHelp.not_comparable: The periods differ in length (for example 4 and 5 weeks).
ruleHelp.negative_baseline: The baseline is negative, so a percentage change is flagged.
ruleHelp.scope_missing: An expected scope has no value in the roll-up.

problem.formula__syntax: The formula has a syntax error. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__undefined_variable: The formula uses an undefined variable. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__kind_mismatch: The formula combines kinds that do not fit. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__currency_product: The formula multiplies two currency amounts. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__currency_mismatch: The formula mixes currencies; there is no FX conversion. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__period_mismatch: The formula combines values with different periods; convert them with to_period. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__invalid_variable: A variable declaration is not valid. Nothing was saved.
problem.formula__division_by_zero: Division by zero: the result is Unknown.
problem.formula__missing_input: An input is missing: the result is Unknown.
problem.formula__result_out_of_range: The result does not fit the stored precision: it is Unknown.
